integrity: Closed-form proof supported by independently executable supplementary finite tests; finite tests are not a proof of the universal quantifier.
scientific_limitations: Direct finite weighted real group-Euclidean sum only; no claim about latent group norms, other fidelities or infinite groups; local defect as step tends to zero. Historical priority may be affected by unindexed equivalents.
title: Exact semigroup rigidity for overlapping Euclidean group penalties
